from pysat.solvers import Glucose3, Minisat22, Cadical153
from pysat.card import CardEnc, EncType
from pysat.formula import CNF, IDPool
import itertools, time
n=14
pairs=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1,n)]
var={p:k+1 for k,p in enumerate(pairs)}
cnf=CNF()
# forbidden cycles length 3,4,5 unique
for L in [3,4,5]:
    cycles=set()
    for verts in itertools.combinations(range(n),L):
        start=min(verts); rest=[v for v in verts if v!=start]
        for perm in itertools.permutations(rest):
            if perm[0]>perm[-1]: continue
            cyc=(start,)+perm
            edges=[]
            for a,b in zip(cyc,cyc[1:]+(cyc[0],)):
                if a>b:a,b=b,a
                edges.append(var[(a,b)])
            cycles.add(tuple(sorted(edges)))
    for c in cycles:
        cnf.append([-x for x in c])
    print(L, len(cycles))
# edge count >=26
vpool=IDPool(start_from=len(pairs)+1)
card=CardEnc.atleast(lits=list(var.values()), bound=26, vpool=vpool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
cnf.extend(card.clauses)
print('vars', cnf.nv, 'clauses', len(cnf.clauses))
for Solver in [Cadical153, Glucose3, Minisat22]:
    t=time.time()
    try:
      with Solver(bootstrap_with=cnf.clauses) as s:
        res=s.solve()
        print(Solver.__name__, res, 'time', time.time()-t)
        if res:
            model=s.get_model()
            ed=[p for p in pairs if model[var[p]-1]>0]
            print(len(ed), ed)
            raise SystemExit
    except Exception as e: print('err', Solver, e)
